end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line directions using everyday comparisons such as a standing, lying, and leaning pencil. Om explained that slanting lines are straight but tilted, and later corrected the mix-up between slanting and curving by identifying the two straight slanting lines in V. At home, ask Om to sort drawn examples into standing, sleeping, and slanting groups, saying why each belongs.
